$Comment: What each player who fought the Headless Horseman sees the instant he falls: his own headline,
and under it the library's share line, which ships translated in every language the library
does. His binding row points its Defeated beat here (Feedback.Defeated).
The moment fires once per credited player and carries 'share' (that player's share of the fight
as whole percent points, the top player reading 100, which is what their daily Claim's rolls were
scaled by) and 'seconds' (how long the fight took). What their rolls put in their Claims lists
itself as rows under the headline on the in-page toast. Gold Reward tone and the game's own
discovery sting, as the library's own defeat moment has.
